items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: I'd heard the name, but I wasn't acquainted with the playing... I don't know anything about him, either.

ctx.x: Did Bunk ever talk about going any other places, any other countries, like Japan or China or Africa or anything else?

I can't remember that offhand. I can't remember that offhand. The only other place he talked about that I can recall was the little town on the Texas border that he spent some time in. Yeah. And I remember him talking about that. But one thing I should mention before I forget, and that is talking about the lessons, that at one point there he was saying that he would make me another Randy Brooks.
